description: Record a stamped surface in the reader's history so it can be compared and reopened later. Call it AFTER emit_runbook_surface, and PASS ITS `payload` — that stores the reading itself rather than a link to it. Silently no-ops when nobody is signed in.

lens.description: The lens the reading was made through (e.g. "explain"), so history can show it.

payload.description: The compiled surface emit_runbook_surface returned (its `payload`). PASS IT. Without it the row is a link only, and a link depends on a renderer staying reachable — with it the reading is stored portably and can be re-rendered or exported long after any URL stops working.

source_title.description: The original article's headline, kept beside source_url.

source_url.description: The original article, so history stays attributable.

title.description: The ANALYSIS title (yours), not the source headline.

url.description: The stamped surface url returned by emit_runbook_surface.

name: save_reading

available.description: False when there is no signed-in reader or the store failed.

portable.description: True when the payload was stored with it.

saved.description: True when the row was stored.

warning.description: Why the payload was not stored.
